decisions.reason: The abstract directly states 'One of these co-morbidities is a decline in cardiac function' in the context of discussing co-morbidities of the neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses (NCLs). The quote explicitly establishes that NCLs have this co-morbidity. 'Decline in cardiac function' is a cardiac phenotype that directly corresponds to 'cardiac dysfunction'. The grammatical subject (NCLs/neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses) clearly possesses this phenotype.
